title: Move the batch-member launch glue out of engram_turn_checks.rs into engram_batch_binds.rs
outcome: The batch-member capture currently sits inline in note_engram_command_finished_with_capture: the off-lock held-claims read, the member collection and the unbindable lines. It moves into one helper in engram_batch_binds.rs, leaving a single call in engram_turn_checks.rs. That helper returns the read target before the lock is released, and the targets and lines after. The move is a pure code move with behaviour unchanged. engram_turn_checks.rs stops growing past the ~3,000-line Rust module threshold (3,177 lines on freeze 741a9b7d).
acceptance: Move the batch-member launch glue out of engram_turn_checks.rs into engram_batch_binds.rs is done
